terms.def: Swiss dispensing category (A to E), given in the packs section.
Arzneimittel-Zulassungsverordnung: the Swissmedic ordinance on authorisation requirements, whose annexes set the Fachinformation and patient information.
Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods; AUST R numbers identify registered medicines.
Consumer Medicine Information: the Australian patient leaflet, with a one-page summary.
Drug Identification Number: the eight-digit number Health Canada assigns to a drug product.
Electronic Vigilance System: Swissmedic’s portal for reporting adverse reactions (ElViS 2.0 from December 2026).
The Swiss information for healthcare professionals.
The symbol on Canadian labels and monographs of prescription drugs.
The Canadian factual document on a drug, for healthcare professionals, with Patient Medication Information.
WHO Public Assessment Report for a prequalified product; Part 4 is the SmPC.
